name: ai-agency-tools
description: Node.js tools for AI Agency: n8n workflow validation

scripts.preinstall-validator: node -e "const m=+process.versions.node.split('.')[0]; if(m<22){console.error('Need Node >=22 (now '+process.version+'). Upgrade: https://nodejs.org'); process.exit(1)} console.log('Node', process.version, 'OK')"
scripts.install-validator: npm run preinstall-validator && npm install --registry https://registry.npmjs.org n8n-workflow-validator@^1.4.2 --no-fund --no-audit --save

_install_notes: У вас в логе был Node v20.20.2 → EBADENGINE. Нужен upgrade до 22+.
Deprecation uuid/gm/glob — от зависимостей n8n, на валидатор не влияют.
